# Recipe Atlas

> Recipe Atlas is a world cuisine recipe explorer with authentic recipes from 86 countries across 7 regions, alongside a calendar of real food festivals and events from around the world.

Recipe Atlas organises its content by geographic region and country. Each recipe includes full ingredients, step-by-step instructions, prep and cook times, and cultural background on the dish's origin. The site also maintains an events section covering food festivals, markets and tastings worldwide, plus a blog of articles on food history and technique.

## Regions

- [Europe](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/europe): Recipes from Italy, France, Spain, Germany, and other European countries
- [North America](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/north_america): Recipes from the United States, Mexico, Canada, and the Caribbean
- [South America](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/south_america): Recipes from Brazil, Argentina, Peru, and neighbouring countries
- [Africa](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/africa): Recipes from Morocco, Nigeria, Ethiopia, and other African countries
- [Middle East](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/middle_east): Recipes from Lebanon, Turkey, Iran, and neighbouring countries
- [Asia](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/asia): Recipes from Japan, China, India, Thailand, and other Asian countries
- [Oceania](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/oceania): Recipes from Australia, New Zealand, and Pacific Island nations

## Popular Recipes

- [Spaghetti Carbonara](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/europe/italy/spaghetti-carbonara): Classic Roman pasta with eggs, Pecorino Romano and guanciale
- [Ramen](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/asia/japan/ramen): Japanese noodle soup with a rich pork broth
- [Pad Thai](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/asia/thailand/pad-thai): Thailand's stir-fried rice noodle dish
- [Tacos al Pastor](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/north_america/mexico/tacos-al-pastor): Mexican spit-roasted pork tacos
- [Butter Chicken](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/asia/india/butter-chicken): Creamy North Indian tomato-based chicken curry
- [Steak Frites](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/europe/france/steak-frites): The French bistro classic of steak and fries

## Other Sections

- [Events](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/events): Food festivals, markets and tastings from around the world, browsable by region, country and month
- [Blog](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/blog): Articles on food history, technique and culture
- [Pantry to Plate](https://www.recipeatlas.co.uk/pantry-to-plate): Find recipes based on ingredients you already have
